Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier today. Per our call I’m sharing the compliance bundle we discussed so your security and procurement teams can begin their review. Attached you’ll find: redwood_soc2_evidence_2026_v1.zip (includes SOC 2 report excerpt, control matrix, and sample audit logs) and attestation_summary_2026.xlsx.

A quick recap of agreed next steps:
- You’ll share the bundle with your security team for an initial pass this week.
- If there are any gaps, we’ll set a 30-minute follow-up with Priyom (our solutions engineer) to walk through specifics.
- Target for a procurement decision: end of month (Dec 31) — let me know if that timeline has shifted.

If it’s helpful I’m happy to join a quick sync with your security reviewer — proposed slots Fri 10–11am PT or Mon 9–10am PT.

Thanks,

Hi Soojin —

Sorry for the slow reply. Security did an initial pass and flagged two small items:

1) They’d like an export sample that shows per-request metadata (timestamp, request_id, model_version).
2) They asked for confirmation on your data retention default (are logs retained 90 days by default or configurable per-tenant?).

Priyom — can you share a screenshot/example of the export format and a short note on retention policy? If possible, we’d love the export example today so we can wrap this up before the procurement review on Thursday.

Alex
